data.narrative:
Skyeton is a Growth-stage company in the Defense & Security sector founded by Oleksandr Stepura. The valuation universe comprises 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems. This represents a narrow comp set within a 24-company Defense & Security peer population.

Peer-median analysis is not applicable to this valuation. Of the 24 same-sector peers identified, none satisfied simultaneous filters for stage alignment, valuation tier proximity, or adjacency clustering. The analysis required a minimum of 3 datapoints to support a median-based benchmark; the filtered universe yielded zero matches across all three filter combinations. Relying on an unfiltered sector median would introduce substantial methodological error given the heterogeneity of Defense & Security company profiles by scale and technology maturity.

The absence of a tight comparable set constrains the analysis to qualitative benchmarking against the identified private and public peers. Any valuation conclusion should acknowledge this constraint and rest primarily on revenue multiples, growth trajectory, or comparable transaction precedent if available from the broader peer set, rather than on statistical median derivation. Further diligence on capital efficiency, customer concentration, and time-to-revenue inflection would be necessary to triangulate a defensible valuation range.
